command: docker exec swccg-official-app-1 mvn -pl gemp-swccg-server -am -Dtest=NativeProofTakeelOracleTests -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test
timing: No Takeel action during battle initiation, weapons, before drawing, either individual destiny draw, or individual draw-complete responses.
After both players complete destiny drawing, Light receives the first optional response. After Light passes, Dark can play Takeel if both drew exactly one and 1 Force remains.
Selecting Takeel opens an empty Use 1 Force optional response while Takeel remains in Hand and Force remains 1.
After passing Force-use responses, 1 Force is in Used, Takeel is in VOID, and numbers have not yet switched.

After card-play responses, numbers switch, Takeel reaches Lost (GEMP represents top card as TOP_OF_LOST_PILE), and a post-placement response resolves before returning to the original both-draws response window.
physicalDestinies: Light Jawa and Dark Stormtrooper remain in their respective owners Used piles before and after Takeel; only destiny numbers switch.
scope: Closed Intro 2PG fixture: original 60 cards per side, four troopers each at Docking Bay 327, Dark 2 Force/Light 1 Force, Takeel in Dark hand. One additional missing-Force fixture starts Dark with 1 Force. No upstream production rule code changed.
